title: Michael in a capsule with floating objects, bumping into Mario on a table
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was in another empty space or capsule or something and I saw things that was flying around, floating around rather

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran from the missile fields near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says that in 1977 he found himself aboard a craft, in "another empty space or capsule or something," with things "floating around" him. He tells Michels he lived it himself, and that he came upon his fellow airman Mario Woods on a table there. If true, two servicemen at a nuclear missile site were taken aboard the same craft.
